content:
alex: Hey team — ACME private VPC onboarding finished on infra side. Quick ask: where should SRE look for their forwarded Prom metrics + traces? Customer says Grafana link but it’s blank for us.

maria: @alex thanks. For metrics we should be looking at the remote_write target in our Prom setup: `prometheus-prod-acme` -> remote_write -> https://rw-prod.redwood.example/acme

samir: Grafana dashboard for that tenant is at https://grafana.redwood.example/d/acme/tenant-overview?orgId=acme — but note it requires the acme org cookie; if you don’t see panels it’s probably a datasource permission issue.

julie: Also check OTLP traces in Tempo: trace namespace is `acme-vpc`. Use Trace search with `resource.attributes.account_id=acme`. Explorer link: https://tempo.redwood.example/explore

alex: I only see an empty dashboard, can someone paste the exact datasource name? I want to confirm whether remote_write actually landed.

maria: Datasource name is `prom-acme-remote` in Grafana. If Grafana shows "no data", verify prom remote_write logs with: 
```
kubectl -n prometheus logs prometheus-xx | grep -i remote_write
```

samir: If remote_write is being blocked by the customer's firewall the metrics won't arrive. Quick check from the prom pod: `kubectl exec -it prometheus-xx -- curl -v https://rw-prod.redwood.example/acme/remote_write` — look for 200 vs 403.

otlp-bot: OTLP ingest: last received batch from acme-vpc at 2026-03-15T18:22:41Z, 120 spans. Ingest latency 230ms.

julie: For logs they should be forwarding via promtail -> loki (or OTLP). Tenant logs: https://loki.redwood.example/tenant/acme/logs — check `source` label for their promtail config.

alex: Great. Any alerting adjustments we should do before handing to customer? They reported noisy CPU alerts during nightly jobs.

maria: Recommend bumping the `cpu_high` alert to 85% and adding `for: 10m` for that tenant. Also add a scheduled suppression (02:00-03:30) as a temporary silence for their batch window. :thumbsup:

samir: I’ll open a PR with the alert change + tests and link it here.

alex: Please tag me when the PR is up and paste curl output if you see 403 from remote_write.

julie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/789 — includes alert tweak and tenant test. cc @samir

alex: Thanks — I’ll run through the handoff checklist tomorrow AM and confirm with CustOps.
